target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
./collatz_tests post-exit --octave-min 22 --seeds-per-octave 30000 --apertures 6 --post-len 32 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "=== post-exit M_post(1): is it < 1 (subcritical)? ==="
awk -F, '!/^#/ && $5>=16 {n++; m+=$8; if($8<1)sub++; klp1+=$7; klp+=$6}
  END{ if(n)printf "windows=%d  mean M_post(1)=%.4f  frac(M<1)=%.3f\n  mean KL_to_p=%.4f  KL_to_p1=%.4f\n",n,m/n,sub/n,klp/n,klp1/n }' out/post_exit.csv
echo "=== with next critical excursion: gap distribution ==="
awk -F, '!/^#/ && $13==1 {n++; g+=$15} END{if(n)printf "events with a next critical: %d, mean gap_steps=%.1f\n",n,g/n; else print "none had a subsequent critical excursion"}' out/post_exit.csv
